This role involves commissioning electrical systems within L0-L6 levels, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, and ensuring the safe and controlled commissioning of data centers. The ideal candidate has a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field and extensive experience in testing, commissioning, or maintenance of complex electrical systems. They must be fluent in English, have expertise in critical power distribution and protection principles, and be able to evaluate technical documentation and resolve issues independently.
what_we_expect: Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, several years of hands-on experience in testing, commissioning, or maintaining complex electrical systems.

Experience in data centers or other mission-critical environments, such as power plants, hospitals, or industrial facilities, and a proven track record in managing test programs, cross-disciplinary interfaces, and technical problem-solving under pressure.
Deep expertise in critical power distribution, protection principles, and the complete L0–L6 commissioning lifecycle, including BAS/EPMS interfaces and integrated system testing logic.
Analytical, highly organized, fluent in English, strong ability to evaluate technical documentation, perform root-cause analysis on test deviations, and independently drive issue resolution.
Willingness to work on-site around Finland, handle non-standard working hours when needed, and start on short notice in an international project environment.
job_responsibilities: Reviewing and developing commissioning plans, responsibility matrixes, test programs, test scripts and acceptance criteria.
Assessing the commissioning readiness of equipment and systems prior to the start of testing phases.
Participating in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), evaluating results, and documenting findings.
Providing technical support for L2-level equipment and installation inspections, as well as L3-level start-up and functional tests.
Planning, monitoring, verifying results for L4-level system and functional tests.
Supporting the planning and execution of the L5 Integrated System Test (IST) phase and verifying inter-system functionality.
what_we_offer: A key role in the safe and controlled commissioning of a technically demanding data center.
An opportunity to work with critical electrical systems and integrated testing in an international environment.
A vantage point at the interface of the client, commissioning organization, designers, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
Support from Granlund's extensive expertise in data centers, electrical systems, automation, and project management.
Continuous recruitment process with two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test to find the right talent for the right position.

jobs.description: Eltel Networks Oy is seeking a Commissioning (Cx) Specialist for their growing Data Center team in Kuopio, Lahti, Espoo, and Tampere. This role focuses on commissioning levels L1 to L5 of data center electrical systems, requiring strong attention to detail and documentation skills. The position is based at any of Eltel's 50 offices across Finland and operates in a hybrid model. Key responsibilities include executing commissioning phases, developing and executing detailed test scripts, coordinating live energization sequences, and attending comprehensive blackout tests and failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) testing.
what_we_expect: Technical expertise: Solid technical understanding of data center electrical distribution systems (MV/LV cabling, TX, RMU, busbar, CB etc.) and backup power solutions (UPS, batteries, and generators).

Commissioning & Testing Experience: Proven experience in electrical commissioning, technical testing, or quality validation roles within industrial sites, substations, or mission-critical data centers.
Process Knowledge: Deep familiarity with data center commissioning workflows, standard L1L5 definitions, and structured testing methodologies.
Standard & Safety Knowledge: Strong understanding of SFS and IEC standards and practical application of operational Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) methodologies in energized environments.
Communication skills: Professional communication skills with the ability to operate comfortably in an English/Finnish-speaking project environment.
job_responsibilities: Commissioning Execution (Levels L1 to L5): Execute data center commissioning phases from factory acceptance testing (FAT) up to integrated systems testing (IST), covering levels L1, L2, L3, L4, and L5.
Test Scripting & Documentation: Develop, review, and execute detailed commissioning test scripts, method statements, and inspection checklists for electrical infrastructure.

Electrical System Testing & Energization: Coordinate and execute component and system-level testing for Medium Voltage (MV), Low Voltage (LV), MV & LV Switchgear, Transformers (TX), UPS systems, battery banks, SCADA and BMS/EPMS. Plan and supervise safe live energization sequences.
Load Bank & Functional Testing (L4): Manage dynamic functional testing, including load bank testing for UPS and generators, steps-load tests, and heat load testing to validate system stability.

Integrated Systems Testing (L5/IST): Attend to comprehensive blackout tests, failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) testing, and redundancy validations to ensure the data center achieves full concurrent maintainability.

HSE Leadership & Energy Isolation: Adhere to Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) protocols, manage complex Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) protocols and specialized Permit to Work (PTW) systems to safely isolate energy during operational testing and live phases.
